headline: GameChanger Law advises investors on InspeCity ₹100 crore pre-Series A fundraise
sum: Inspecity Space Laboratories Private Limited has raised ₹100 crore from a pre-Series A fundraise co-led by Speciale Invest and Ashish Kacholia, with participation from Antler India, Antler Elevate, Shastra VC and a group of angel…
detail: Inspecity Space Laboratories Private Limited has raised ₹100 crore from a pre-Series A fundraise co-led by Speciale Invest and Ashish Kacholia, with participation from Antler India, Antler Elevate, Shastra VC and a group of angel investors. First Principles Law advised InspeCity on this fundraise. GameChanger Law Advisors advised lead investor Speciale Invest and angel investor Manish Gandhi on this fundraise. The Firm assisted with structuring, drafting, reviewing and negotiating the transaction documentation.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
